definitions.title: Rolle's Theorem
definitions.latex: f(a) = f(b) \implies \exists c \in (a, b) \text{ s.t. } f'(c) = 0
definitions.statement: Suppose f is continuous on [a, b] and differentiable on (a, b). If f(a) = f(b), then there exists at least one point c in (a, b) where f'(c) = 0.
definitions.explanation: If a smooth curve starts and ends at the same horizontal level, it must have at least one horizontal tangent in between.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Matching endpoints on a smooth curve guarantee a horizontal tangent.

definitions.title: The Mean Value Theorem (MVT)
definitions.statement: If f is continuous on [a, b] and differentiable on (a, b), then there exists at least one point c in (a, b) where the instantaneous rate of change f'(c) equals the average rate of change [f(b) - f(a)] / (b - a).
definitions.explanation: Geometrically, there is at least one tangent line parallel to the secant line joining endpoints (a, f(a)) and (b, f(b)).
definitions.keyTakeaway: Instantaneous slope must equal average slope at some interior point.
